summary: RC validation of the converted->won migration fix. Upgrade rehearsal passes: the row-count diff shows only the new tables 'crews 1' and 'lead_follow_ups 0', settings unchanged: yes, job assignments unchanged: yes. Statuses after are archived:35, contacted:127, new:229, qualified:3, won:149. Expected won=149 and contacted=127 match the actual result, and there are 0 won leads without an accepted proposal, 0 legacy statuses left, and 0 jobs with a text crew but no crew_id. Inspections are completed:145 and head is b1f0c2d3e4a5. `alembic heads` shows one head and `alembic current` = b1f0c2d3e4a5. The rehearsal did not change the working DB: leads and jobs full-table md5 were identical before and after, lead counts stayed archived:35/contacted:122/new:237/won:149 (543 total), and the copy DB was dropped. The Field map_data_flow node test passes. Office smoke as owner and sales_bk passed: Home, Leads, Lead Detail (read-only), Jobs and Job Detail render. The follow-up dialog's shadcn calendar opens on a TEST_ lead and Cancel closes it with no follow-up saved. Test data was removed by manual_end (1 lead, 1 property) and the leads md5 matches the baseline again.

minor.issue: Returns 502 'Could not retrieve photo' on Job Detail JOB-0002 (a35ce38c...). It is the only console error on the owner smoke. The object-storage file for an old test photo is missing (likely lost in a DB restore), and the router turns every get_object exception into a 502. This is not caused by this release. Suggest returning 404/410 when the object is missing so ingress 502s are not confused with real outages.

issues: The Cancel button has no data-testid (FollowUpDialog.jsx line 84). Tests have to select it by role/name.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid='followup-cancel-button' to the FollowUpDialog Cancel button.
Optional: make /api/mobile/photos/{id}/content return 404 when the stored object is missing, instead of 502.

Optional, rehearsal hardening: add `trap 'psql "$BASE/postgres" -qc "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS $COPY"' EXIT` so a failed downgrade or upgrade does not leave rs_upgrade_rehearsal behind. Stop sending the downgrade output to /dev/null, and add assertions that make the script exit non-zero (expected won vs actual won, contacted, and legacy=0) instead of only printing the values.

Optional, stale test semantics: in map_data_flow.node.test.js the RT5 regexes still look for putCache(CACHE_MAP_PROPS, []) and CACHE_SECTIONS. MapScreen now uses a per-area `${CACHE_MAP_PROPS}:${area.id}` cacheKey and CACHE_AREAS, so those two checks always pass and protect nothing. RT3's block-scoped check still covers the loadPropsForArea catch path. Also, the reducer invariants RT4 and 'zero sections keeps full map' no longer match the Map Areas design: selecting an area triggers a per-area refetch via the useEffect at lines 249-253, and a null area sets features to []. Consider updating them to CACHE_AREAS/cacheKey and rewording the header.
critical_code_review_comments: Migration b1f0c2d3e4a5 is correct for the approved rule. Order: working->contacted, interested->qualified, then converted->won only with EXISTS (quotes.lead_id = leads.id AND status='accepted'), then the rest of converted->contacted. Nothing is deleted on upgrade. inspections.status gets server_default 'completed', so existing rows become completed (145/145 in the rehearsal).

The won rule only looks at quotes.lead_id. 629 of 834 accepted quotes have lead_id NULL and are linked only through customer_id. In the working DB, 7 'contacted' leads share a customer with such an accepted quote. In a real legacy install those leads would map converted->contacted, not won. This matches the owner-approved correction list: all 7 are in scripts/data/converted_won_correction_ids.txt. So it is consistent and not a defect, but the product owner should know about it.

downgrade() does not restore legacy lead statuses, so the status change is one-way. It drops lead_follow_ups, which loses that data on downgrade. Acceptable for a forward-only release, but it should be documented.

Rehearsal script: the legacy-status simulation makes converted from won/contacted leads that have a customer_id, giving 271 converted leads, 122 of them without an accepted proposal. Both branches of the fix are exercised. The rehearsal uses the working DB's data, not a real legacy dump. The temp files are written under /app/memory and removed at the end.
